newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC PROFIT IN SWITZERLAND ROCKETS 750 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SBC PROFIT IN SWITZERLAND ROCKETS 750 PCT.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp. (SBC) said net profit at its SBC Switzerland division soared 750 percent to 119 million Swiss francs from 14 million as efforts to improve the division's profitability took effect.

"The action taken last year to bring about a sustained improvement in the profitability in personal and commercial banking in Switzerland is having the desired effect," SBC said in its six month statement.
SBC also said first-half profits at SBC Warburg, the group's investment arm, rose 60 percent to 691 million francs.
"Investment banking for the first time furnished the biggest profit contribution of all four divisions," SBC said.

In the Private Banking division, net profit rose 36 percent to 653 million francs as assets under management rose some 22 percent since mid-1996, partly due to the appreciation in value of assets already managed and partly due to new money.

SBC Brinson's six-month profit rose 121.4 percent to 62 million francs from 28 million, partly because income from managing mutual funds taken over from SBC Private Banking accrued to SBC Brinson for the first time in 1997.
SBC Brinson had 192 billion francs in institutional assets under management mid-1997.
